description: Four-channel polyphonic stereo mixer for audio or CV, one level knob per stereo pair, with options to clip the mix or strip DC from it

params.text: Attenuates, inverts or amplifies both sides of that numbered stereo input before the mix; the MODE button sets what the knob's range means
Attenuates, inverts or amplifies the stereo mix; the MODE button sets what the knob's range means
Cycles five level scales: unipolar dB, unipolar dB with polyphonic inputs summed to mono, and bipolar percent, x2 and x10; a bipolar scale gives constant CV only when both sides are unpatched
Cycles eight clipping settings for the mix: off, hard or soft at 10V taken before or after the mix level, oversampled soft versions of those, and a saturate at 6V
Cycles DC offset removal through off, before clipping, before and after clipping, and after clipping

inputs.text: The left side of that numbered stereo input; patched on its own it feeds both sides, because the right input is normalled to it
The right side of that numbered stereo input, normalled to the left input of the same pair

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, after the mix level knob, the clipping and the DC blocking; both mix outputs carry the same number of polyphonic channels
The right side of the mix, after the mix level knob, the clipping and the DC blocking; both mix outputs carry the same number of polyphonic channels

notes: mix expanders added in an unbroken chain to the right bring mute, solo, fade, pan, offset and send controls to the four channels
menu: Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%; on the oversampled soft clipping settings
Add Mix Offset expander (Only 1, must be 1st), Add Mix Mute expander (Only 1) and Add Mix Solo expander (Only 1) — each places that expander immediately to the right
Add Mix Fade expander (only 1, needs Mute or Solo to left), Add Mix Fade 2 expander (only 1, needs Mute or Solo to left) and Add Mix Aux Send expander — each places that expander to the right
Add Mix Pan expander (only 1) — places a MIX PAN immediately to the right
